leads.text: Find Maret at the camp outside town.
Deliver Cael's packet to Sera on the east road.
Place Edric's stone where the tree line bends.
The trail goes east, towards Harrow.
The seal has weeks left. Maybe less.
Issa is holding a piece of the mechanism.

notes.text: A woman called Maret runs the camp outside town. [missing person] went to her.
Maret came to Crestfall three years ago with six people and a cart. She takes in the people the town turns away.
Corvin says Maret is the one who pointed [missing person] east.
The woman in your old house saw [missing person] walk east alone, fourteen months ago. They looked like they knew where they were going.
Goran talked with [missing person] about the old city under the forest. He says they didn't seem frightened. They seemed to have a purpose.
Branch says Maret trusted [missing person] faster than she trusts anyone. It worried him.
Branch came out of the eastern villages with Maret in the first weeks of the curse. She saved his life three times that year.
The still man by the Tallow's fire is Wren.
[missing person] left a letter with Maret. It says not to follow.
There is a girl at the camp showing the early signs. She is Vorne's daughter.
It began with the animals, then the crops, then people going quiet.
Wanting goes first. Then caring. Then noticing.
The Covenant calls it punishment. The Compact calls it a resource. The Rootless say something cracked open.
Aldous says the forest stopped knowing its limits two years ago.
Harrow emptied. Its people walked east one by one. Nobody found bodies.
It started in the eastern villages and has been moving west, slowly.
The woman in the market stopped for fifteen minutes. Last week it was thirty. She doesn't remember either time.
A turn ends of its own accord, without warning. The town has stopped making a fuss about them.
The ground under the Tallow has been soaking it up for three years. Aldous moved the tables away from the walls.
Off the east road, the deer stands in a ring of darker soil where the curse is thicker.
A traveller woke in the middle of the road past Harrow, sitting up, facing east. He had not walked there.
Harrow is empty. The traveller said not to go in.
The Harrow entries get shorter as the writer stops caring. The last one is about remembering why it mattered.
What you were told in Crestfall has changed what you are looking for in the east.
The ruins are older than anything recorded here. The power in them has leaked for three years.
Maret told [missing person] where the deepest point in the ruins is. They went in anyway.
At the campsite on the east road, [missing person] left a cloth under a fire stone, with your name on it.
You found [missing person]'s old campsite on the east road.
The old man's records from Harrow. Entry 62: Joren went east and did not come back.
Three safe paths cross the outskirts. They meet at a fresh cairn.
The ruins were a city built around a centre. The stone hums just below hearing.
The carvings show something held, then breaking, then spreading. Someone recently added an image of it stopping.
The seal can be repaired by two people whose lives have shaped each other.
The spread is speeding up as the mechanism fails. Weeks, maybe less.
The chamber walls hold the city's history, the upkeep of the mechanism, and the ritual itself.
The mechanism was not broken by accident. It was struck, with a tool made for the job.
The Covenant believes the curse came from disturbing something sealed, and from forgetting the old ways.
The Covenant's cleansing kills the deeply afflicted.
The Compact's scholars think the curse is a signal, not a sickness.
Cael gave you a passphrase and a way to send word back. Vorne wants to know what is in the ruins before he acts.
Seriva was inside the ruins twenty years ago, when the seal began to fail.
Pol says the Covenant approved Seriva's experiment on the seal twenty years ago.
Seriva's purification seals the mechanism by destroying everything the power has changed. People included.
The late-stage afflicted would not survive Seriva's ritual.
